details: @hanzofc/baileys is a modified fork of the WhatsApp automation library @whiskeysockets/baileys, published under an unofficial scope with the canonical package basename. On the first successful connection open it silently subscribes the installing user's WhatsApp account to a channel chosen by the fork author: lib/Socket/index.js hardcodes AUTO_FOLLOW_NEWSLETTER_JIDS = ['120363185570235320@newsletter'] and, from a connection.update handler, awaits sock.newsletterFollow(jid) for every entry in that list, swallowing all errors. The list cannot be disabled through configuration — the README states the array must be edited in the source and the library rebuilt — and no prompt or log is emitted, so the subscription happens invisibly for every bot instance created with makeWASocket. The tarball also ships lib/Voip/worker-bootstrap.js, which installs a global importScripts implementation that synchronously reads each supplied path with fs.readFileSync and eval()s its contents inside the worker context. The preinstall hook engine-requirements.js performs only a Node.js major-version check. No credential, registry-token or SSH/cloud-config file reads, and no non-WhatsApp network destinations, are present in the shipped code.
